title: Gateless Barrier, Case 32: The Buddha Responds to an Outsider
speaker: Nomon Tim Burnett
summary: The talk emphasizes the importance of embracing uncertainty and silence in order to cultivate courage and wisdom. In a world filled with constant talking and distraction, it's essential to practice "emptiness" by letting go of all views and acknowledging the unknown nature of reality. By doing so, we can develop the strength and clarity needed to navigate life's challenges, including those presented by uncertainty and fear.
